 India A vs Nepal Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi Included in Playing XI as Nepal Opts to Bowl 
 By Varun Verma Last Updated: Nov 20, 2026, 15:34 IST India A take on Nepal in the Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 on November 20. Check the latest toss update, confirmed playing XIs, match details and team combinations.
 India A vs Nepal 
 India A will take on Nepal in their first match of the Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 on Friday, November 20. The crucial Group B clash will take place at the West End Park International Cricket Stadium in Doha, Qatar.  
 India A will feature some exciting young names, whereas Nepal will look to make a mark against one of the best teams in the world. 
 Check out the match details, including the date, time, venue, toss, playing XI and key players to watch out for.

 India A vs Nepal Toss Update 
 Nepal won the toss and elected to bowl first against India A in their opening match of the Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026. 
 India A Playing XI vs Nepal 
 India A's batting lineup will feature Abhishek Sharma and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi as the opening pair. Captain Tilak Varma will lead the side, with Ayush Badoni and Rinku Singh strengthening the middle order. Kumar Kushagra will handle the wicketkeeping duties, while Shahbaz Ahmed and Suryansh Shedge will provide all-round options. The bowling department will feature Vipraj Nigam, Harshit Rana and Prince Yadav.
